payload.objective: Resolve the confirmed current release-document/package gap without rewriting historical evidence or frozen specifications.
instructions: Make a minimal current-checkout update to RELEASE.md that identifies the canonical dist/council-flow.zip, notes that the Round 6 statements/reports below are historical, and describes current bundle contents/checks using the actual implementation. Do not rewrite historical evidence files.

Build dist/council-flow.zip from an explicit repository-root allowlist: complete .agents/skills/council-flow, four .codex/agents/council-*.toml files, README and RELEASE, demos, tests, docs relevant to frozen requirements/full plan, and selected clearly historical reports. Preserve repository-relative POSIX paths.

Exclude .git, Python caches/pyc, credentials, runtime state, temp files, the archive itself, the entire current hardening packet directory, unrelated projects, and generated caches. Generate sibling SHA256 file.

Verify CRC, every archive path safe/relative, required contents present, forbidden contents absent, and every packaged file matches current worktree bytes. Extract in an isolated temporary directory and run the relevant product/contract/application suites plus root-bound operational JSON example commands. Record exact results and archive hash.

Create cumulative candidate manifest and bounded snapshot whose digests bind exact final RELEASE.md and distribution archive/hash bytes; ensure manifest_sha256 in execution record binds final manifest bytes. Be explicit that distribution archive is an output artifact and does not contain current hardening evidence.
Preserve all earlier reports and frozen Gate3 docs unchanged; no product-code changes. Save accurate UTF-8 Worker report and stop.
